| <a id="recordbackendevent"></a> `recordBackendEvent` | \<`T`\>(`ctx`, `event`) => `Promise`\<[`RecordedEventResult`](#recordedeventresult)\> | Record one event on the audit trail, in the caller's transaction when the caller is a mutation: its row, one log line naming only its type and id, and `onEvent`, scheduled once it commits. Refuses an event the catalog does not allow (`invalid_input`, the field named). | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="forgetsubject"></a> `forgetSubject` | (`ctx`, `userId`) => `Promise`\<`void`\> | The audit trail's part of an account's erasure: the account's own record is removed (its personal workspace's with it), and its id becomes a pseudonym in the rows that stay: a workspace's trail, what it did to someone else, and every row an administrator took part in, which no deletion removes. The auth layer runs it when an account is deleted. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="api"></a> `api` | [`AuditApi`](#auditapi) | The public reads `backend/audit.ts` re-exports. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |

### SetupAuditOptions

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts)

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Defined in |
| ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ |
| <a id="onevent"></a> `onEvent?` | [`OnBackendEvent`](#onbackendevent) | Hear of every event once it is recorded, the package's own and yours: an internal action of yours, by its reference, taking `{ event: vBackendEvent }`. Forward an event to a chat channel, an analytics pipeline, a SIEM. The auth layer's events reach it when `setupAuth` gets this instance as `audit`. **Guarantee** - Runs: in an action of its own, scheduled by the transaction that recorded the event, once it commits - Delivery: once per event, fire and forget: nothing retries a run that fails, and the event stays recorded - Order: scheduled in the order events are recorded; runs may overlap, so order across events is not kept - When it throws: the failure is the action's own, in the deployment's logs; the event and what recorded it stand - Idempotency: key what it writes on `event.id` | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="notifications"></a> `notifications?` | \{ `plan`: (`event`) => [`NotificationPlan`](/docs/reference/api/notifications#notificationplan) \| `null`; `deliver?`: () => `Promise`\<`string` \| `undefined`\>; \} | The inbox (`setupNotifications`), so an event of your own that its `notify` names reaches the people it is about as it is recorded, and email and push notifications go out through its `deliverNotification`. The package's own kinds reach the inbox without it. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| `notifications.plan` | (`event`) => [`NotificationPlan`](/docs/reference/api/notifications#notificationplan) \| `null` | - | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| `notifications.deliver?` | () => `Promise`\<`string` \| `undefined`\> | - | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="workspaceroles"></a> `workspaceRoles?` | `string`[] | The workspace roles that read a workspace's activity (`listWorkspaceActivity`). Default `['owner', 'admin']`. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="adminroles"></a> `adminRoles?` | `string`[] | The app-wide roles that read every event (`listAllActivity`), read fresh. Default `['admin']`. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="checklist"></a> `checklist?` | [`Activation`](#activation) | The activation checklist `defineActivation` declares: three to seven first tasks, each done when its event is recorded for the person. `getActivation` serves it to `useActivation` and `<ActivationChecklist>`. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |
| <a id="activation-1"></a> `activation?` | `string` | The event kind that says a person got value from the app: the growth funnel's activation step, recorded once per account as `account.activated`, which starts the `reviewAsk` lifecycle email. One of yours (`app.strip_published`) or one the package records. Default: the account's first event of the app's own (`app.*`). An event recorded while an administrator acts as the account never counts. | [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts) |

## Type Aliases

### ActivationScope

```ts
type ActivationScope = "person" | "workspace";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/activation-rules.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/activation-rules.ts)

Whose events tick a task off: the person's own, or any member's in the workspace they are in.

***

### EventFieldType

```ts
type EventFieldType = 
  | "string"
  | "string?"
  | "string[]"
  | "string[]?"
  | "boolean"
  | "boolean?"
  | "number"
  | "number?";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/events.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/events.ts)

The type of a field an event's `data` carries; `?` marks one it may leave out.

***

### EventScope

```ts
type EventScope = "account" | "workspace" | "entity";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/events.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/events.ts)

Where an event belongs, which decides who reads it:
- `account`: about one account (`subjectId`), read by that account and the
  app's administrators;
- `workspace`: inside one workspace (`entityId`), read by the account it is
  about, the workspace's owners and admins, and the app's administrators;
- `entity`: about a billing entity, which is a workspace (`entityId`, read
  like a workspace's event) or, with `billTo: 'user'`, an account billed on
  its own (`subjectId`, read like an account's event).

***

### EventReader

```ts
type EventReader = "subject" | "workspace" | "admin";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/events.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/events.ts)

Who reads an event's row: the account it is about, the workspace's managers, the app's administrators.

***

The channels an event derives a delivery on, beside its row.

### EventFieldsOf

```ts
type EventFieldsOf<F> = { [K in keyof F as F[K] extends `${string}?` ? never : K]: EventFieldValue<F[K]> } & { [K in keyof F as F[K] extends `${string}?` ? K : never]?: EventFieldValue<F[K]> };
```

### BackendEventData

```ts

```

Defined in: [src/convex/events.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/events.ts)

```ts

```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts)

Your internal action that hears of every event once it is recorded: an
`internalAction` taking `{ event: vBackendEvent }`, passed by its
reference (`internal.audit.onEvent`).

     description: "An administrator (the actor) changed the job queue: `change` is `paused`, `resumed`, `concurrency`, `tier` or `model`, with the `tier` or `model` it retuned.";

  };
  "job.canceled": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        kind: "string";

        running: "boolean";

  };
  "job.retried": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        kind: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly [];

  "ai.spend_limit_reached": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        usd: "number";
        limit: "number";

     description: "What AI cost the whole app today (UTC), `usd`, reached the daily spend limit, `limit` (US dollars), so the app turned the `pause_ai` kill switch on until the next UTC day begins, when it lifts by itself. By the app: no one signed in acted, and the administrators' view shows it.";
     recordedBy: "The cost record that reached `setupAi({ spendLimit })` (`costs.checkSpendLimit` in the `backend` component)";
  };
  "billing.checkout_started": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
     };

     description: "A billing manager opened a checkout for a plan or a pack: `productId` is the provider product. Paying for it records `billing.order_paid`.";

  };
  "billing.plan_changed": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        change: "string";
        productId: "string?";
     };
     channels: readonly ["in-app"];
     description: "A billing manager changed the subscription: `change` is `plan` (to `productId`), `cancel`, `uncancel`, `cancel_pending`, `pause` or `resume`. `targetId` is the subscription.";
     recordedBy: "`billing:updateSubscription`, `cancelSubscription`, `uncancelSubscription`, `cancelPendingChange`, `pauseSubscription` and `resumeSubscription`";

  "billing.subscription_created": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
        interval: "string?";
        trialEndsAt: "number?";
        trialDays: "number?";
     };
     channels: readonly ["in-app"];
     description: "A paid subscription started at the provider. `targetId` is the subscription; `interval` is its billing period (`month`, `year`), and a trial's end (`trialEndsAt`, epoch ms) and length in days (`trialDays`) when it starts with one.";
     recordedBy: "The billing webhook (`/billing/events`), for the entity the customer belongs to; a free plan's own events record nothing";
  };
  "billing.subscription_updated": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
        status: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly [];
     description: "A paid subscription changed at the provider: its plan, its status or its period. `targetId` is the subscription.";
     recordedBy: "The billing webhook (`/billing/events`), for the entity the customer belongs to; a free plan's own events record nothing";
  };
  "billing.subscription_canceled": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
        reason: "string?";
     };
     channels: readonly ["in-app"];
     description: "A paid subscription was canceled: it ends with its period. `reason` is the customer's cancellation reason, when they gave one. `targetId` is the subscription.";
     recordedBy: "The billing webhook (`/billing/events`), for the entity the customer belongs to; a free plan's own events record nothing";

  "billing.subscription_revoked": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";

  "billing.subscription_past_due": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
     };

  "billing.order_paid": {

     recordedBy: "The billing webhook (`/billing/events`), for the entity the customer belongs to; a free plan's own events record nothing";

  "billing.order_refunded": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {

  "billing.refund_issued": {
     scope: "entity";

  "billing.benefit_granted": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        benefitType: "string";

  "billing.benefit_revoked": {
     scope: "entity";

     scope: "entity";

        balance: "number";

  "billing.save_offer_made": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        reason: "string";

  "billing.save_offer_accepted": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        reason: "string";
        offer: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly ["in-app"];

  "billing.checkout_abandoned": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        productId: "string";
     };

  "billing.contract_withdrawn": {

     scope: "entity";

     data: {
        balance: "number";

     scope: "entity";
     data: {
     };

  };

  "gift.pass_ending": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        plan: "string";
        endsAt: "number";
     };

  "gift.pass_ended": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
        plan: "string";
        outcome: "string";
     };

  };
  "gift.refunded": {
     scope: "entity";
     data: {
     };

     };

  "referral.rewarded": {
     scope: "entity";

     };

     scope: "account";

     };

  };
  "email.suppression_lifted": {

The account that holds the address is the subject, when one does; the address is never kept here.";
     recordedBy: "`email:liftSuppression` (`setupEmail`), from the admin console's Suppressions tab";
  };

     scope: "account";
     data: {
        service: "string";

  };
  "consent.granted": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        kind: "string";
        version: "string";
        source: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly [];
     description: "The account agreed to a document or an opt-in, chose optional storage, or passed the age check: the `kind`, the `version` it agreed to (for `storage`, the purposes it allowed; for `age`, the minimum it passed) and where it came from (`sign-up`, `prompt` or `settings`). Never the age typed.";
     recordedBy: "Account creation (`setupAccount`'s required consents), `account:grantConsent` and `account:chooseStorage`";
  };
  "consent.withdrawn": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        kind: "string";
        version: "string";
        source: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly [];
     description: "The account withdrew a consent, or chose to allow no optional storage: the `kind` and the `version` it had agreed to. A required consent can't be withdrawn.";
     recordedBy: "`account:withdrawConsent` and `account:chooseStorage`";

  "account.created": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        invite: "string?";
     };
     channels: readonly [];
     description: "An account was created: the growth funnel's sign-up. `invite` is the label of the invite code or access link that admitted it, or the kind of ticket that let it in (`invite-code`, `access-link`, `waitlist` and the rest `access.ticket_used` names) when it had no label; absent for an account no ticket admitted. Never the address.";
     recordedBy: "The account's creation, by its database hook";
  };
  "account.activated": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        kind: "string";
     };
     channels: readonly [];
     description: "The account reached activation, once: `kind` is the event that counted, the one `setupAudit({ activation })` names, or the account's first event of the app's own (`app.*`) when none is named. An event recorded while an administrator acted as the account never counts. The `reviewAsk` lifecycle email starts from it.";
     recordedBy: "The event path itself, as it records the activation event";
  };
  "account.data_exported": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
     };
     channels: readonly [];

  "account.deletion_scheduled": {
     scope: "account";

     };

  "account.deletion_canceled": {
     scope: "account";

     };

  "account.erasure_failed": {
     scope: "account";
     data: {
        source: "string";
        attempts: "number";

     recordedBy: "An erasure (`account.forget`), once a participant used up its retries";
  };
};

Defined in: [src/convex/events.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/events.ts)

The package's event kinds, by type. Each type is `<area>.<what
happened>`, in the past tense: what it carries, who reads it, what it
derives and what records it.

### vBackendEvent

```ts
const vBackendEvent: VObject<{
  data?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>;
  actorId?: string;
  impersonatorId?: string;
  subjectId?: string;
  entityId?: string;
  targetId?: string;
  type: string;
  id: string;
  at: number;
}, {
  type: VString<string, "required">;
  actorId: VString<string | undefined, "optional">;
  impersonatorId: VString<string | undefined, "optional">;
  subjectId: VString<string | undefined, "optional">;
  entityId: VString<string | undefined, "optional">;
  targetId: VString<string | undefined, "optional">;
  data: VRecord<
     | Record<string, string | number | boolean | string[]>
    | undefined, VString<string, "required">, VUnion<string | number | boolean | string[], [VString<string, "required">, VFloat64<number, "required">, VBoolean<boolean, "required">, VArray<string[], VString<string, "required">, "required">], "required", never>, "optional", string>;
  id: VString<string, "required">;
  at: VFloat64<number, "required">;
}, "required", 
  | "data"
  | "id"
  | "type"
  | "at"
  | "actorId"
  | "impersonatorId"
  | "subjectId"
  | "entityId"
  | "targetId"
  | `data.${string}`> = vRecordedEvent;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts)

The event `onEvent` receives: the row as recorded, with its id and when it
was recorded (epoch ms). Use it as your action's `args`:
`internalAction({ args: { event: vBackendEvent }, handler })`.

## Functions

### defineActivation()

```ts
function defineActivation(tasks): Activation;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/activation-rules.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/activation-rules.ts)

The activation checklist: three to seven first tasks that lead to value,
each done when one of your own events (or one the package records) is
recorded for the person. Pass the result to `setupAudit({ checklist })`.
Throws, naming the problem, when the list has fewer than three or more
than seven tasks, two tasks share a key, or a task is malformed, so a
mistake shows when the deployment loads.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `tasks` | readonly [`ActivationTask`](#activationtask)[] |

#### Returns

[`Activation`](#activation)

#### Example

```ts [backend/activation.ts]
import { defineActivation } from 'nuxt-backend/audit'

export const activation = defineActivation([
  { key: 'photo', label: 'Upload a photo of yourself', done: 'app.photo_uploaded', to: '/studio/photos' },
  { key: 'strip', label: 'Generate your first strip', done: 'app.strip_generated', to: '/studio/new' },
  { key: 'publish', label: 'Publish a strip', done: 'app.strip_published', to: '/studio' },
])
```

***

### setupAudit()

```ts
function setupAudit(components, options?): Audit;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/audit.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/audit.ts)

The shared event path: record an event of the package's catalog or of
your own, read the activity trail back, and hear of every event.

Every sign-in and sign-out, passkey and email change, signed-out device,
workspace invitation, membership and role change, administrator
impersonation is recorded already; add your own with
`recordBackendEvent`. Rows are kept 365 days.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`AuditComponents`](#auditcomponents) |
| `options?` | [`SetupAuditOptions`](#setupauditoptions) |

#### Returns

[`Audit`](#audit)

#### Example

```ts [backend/audit.ts]
import { setupAudit } from 'nuxt-backend/audit'
import { components } from './_generated/api'

export const audit = setupAudit(components)
export const { listActivity, listWorkspaceActivity, listAllActivity } = audit.api
```
